caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a sleeveless, front-buttoned vest positioned centrally on the page. The vest is primarily olive green and is decorated with intricate embroidery in various colors, including pale blue, white, pink, and light green. The decorative motifs on the vest include small scattered floral patterns on the upper half, and more densely arranged, horizontal bands of floral and geometric designs on the lower half. The vest has a stand-up collar and armholes showing a light tan interior lining. To the upper right of the main image, there is a simple, uncolored line drawing showing the back outline of the vest, with no additional detail or ornamentation. The rest of the background is plain and unadorned.
title: Waistcoat
